From 2bf1877b7094c684e1d652cac6912cfbc507ad3e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Zilin Guan <zilin@seu.edu.cn>
Date: Tue, 6 Jan 2026 09:13:17 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] platform/x86/amd: Fix memory leak in wbrf_record()
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The tmp buffer is allocated using kcalloc() but is not freed if
acpi_evaluate_dsm() fails. This causes a memory leak in the error path.

Fix this by explicitly freeing the tmp buffer in the error handling
path of acpi_evaluate_dsm().

Fixes: 58e82a62669d ("platform/x86/amd: Add support for AMD ACPI based Wifi band RFI mitigation feature")
Suggested-by: Ilpo Järvinen <ilpo.jarvinen@linux.intel.com>
Co-developed-by: Jianhao Xu <jianhao.xu@seu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Jianhao Xu <jianhao.xu@seu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Zilin Guan <zilin@seu.edu.cn>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260106091318.747019-1-zilin@seu.edu.cn
Reviewed-by: Ilpo Järvinen <ilpo.jarvinen@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ilpo Järvinen <ilpo.jarvinen@linux.intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/platform/x86/amd/wbrf.c b/drivers/platform/x86/amd/wbrf.c
index dd197b3aebe0..0f58d252b620 100644
--- a/drivers/platform/x86/amd/wbrf.c
+++ b/drivers/platform/x86/amd/wbrf.c
@@ -104,8 +104,10 @@ static int wbrf_record(struct acpi_device *adev, uint8_t action, struct wbrf_ran
 	obj = acpi_evaluate_dsm(adev->handle, &wifi_acpi_dsm_guid,
 				WBRF_REVISION, WBRF_RECORD, &argv4);
 
-	if (!obj)
+	if (!obj) {
+		kfree(tmp);
 		return -EINVAL;
+	}
 
 	if (obj->type != ACPI_TYPE_INTEGER) {
 		ret = -EINVAL;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary

### Modifications per File

**drivers/platform/x86/amd/wbrf.c**
- Added a `kfree(tmp)` call in the error path of `wbrf_record()` when `acpi_evaluate_dsm()` returns `NULL`. The original code returned `-EINVAL` without freeing the previously allocated `tmp` buffer, causing a memory leak. The fix ensures the buffer is freed before returning.

### Relationships

The patch fixes a single memory leak bug by inserting one line of code. The modification is self-contained within one file and directly addresses the missing cleanup for the `tmp` buffer in the failure case of `acpi_evaluate_dsm()`. No other files or functions are affected, and the fix aligns with the standard error handling pattern used elsewhere in the same function (e.g., the later error path for mismatched `obj->type` already frees `tmp`).
